intro: A warm glow flickers up ahead.$A Victini twirls and hops in the middle of the path, tracing little V's of flame in the air as it dances!
title: Victory Victini
description: The Victory Pokémon beams at you, still dancing, and beckons you closer. Its boundless energy promises fortune — but whether that fortune comes from besting it or joining it is up to you.

1.label: Attack Victini
1.tooltip:
(-) Fight a Mythical Boss
(+) Very Rare Rewards
1.selected: Victini's smile vanishes.$Flames gather around it in a blazing V as it accepts your challenge!

2.label: Dance with It
2.tooltip:
(-) A random stat is drained to nothing
(+) The drained power surges into another stat
2.selected: Your Pokémon steps forward and mirrors Victini's dance…$Faster and faster they spin, until a colossal V-Create erupts and swallows them both!

danceComplete: The flames clear, and {{pokemonName}} stands transformed!$Its {{drainedStat}} was drained away — and {{amount}} points of raw power surged into its {{boostedStat}}!
outro:
The dancing flame is gone.
Only a faint warmth remains, like a promise of victory…
